name: agentchi-codex
description: Sends Codex events to your Agentchi watch and lets you answer them from it, through your Agentchi server.

interface.shortDescription: Notifications and replies from your Wear OS watch
interface.longDescription: Relays Codex task completions and permission requests to your Agentchi watch, and sends the answers you give on the watch back to Codex. Pairing code in the AGENTCHI_CODE variable, server in AGENTCHI_SERVER (default https://agentchi.dev).
